name: PBQ NCSU 2026

venue.name: North Carolina State University Witherspoon Student Center

information: **This competition does NOT have the standard 3x3x3 Cube event.** **All competitors must read the [Competitor Information tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBQNCSU2026#62063-competitor-information) prior to registering.** Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email. This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBQNCSU2026#69878-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc5MDYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--55d04463db7d97e68854ce1ad4ffb960c1ed23fd/SOUTHEAST_5.png) Additionally, this competition has been made possible with the help of CubePack, the cubing club at NC State!
